_method: Sampled test posts screened with langid 1.1.6 (all languages) and a >5% non-ASCII-letter ratio (`uv run scripts/prepare_smarter.py --screen`: 78 flags over the 3,119 sampled posts: 37 HateXplain, 28 Latent Hate, 13 Implicit Hate), plus a second pass flagging posts with 2+ distinct German/Spanish/French/Dutch/Portuguese/Italian function words (8 flags, all within or equal to the first set except one English headline). Every flag was judged from the text alone, before any Jev output. Excluded: posts that are wholly or partly (code-mixed or with an appended translation) in a language other than English. Kept: short English, slang, African American English, emoji-heavy and hashtag-only posts misidentified by langid. All 7 exclusions are HateXplain Gab posts; no Latent Hatred post was flagged as non-English.

excluded.reason: English phrase followed by its French translation
